Staff recommended approval.

google-ops-us-p15-dwee-dctf-lb1010-prese.summary: The combined presentation for the Nebraska Data Center Task Force meeting of 20 October 2026 opens with DWEE's 'LB1010 (2026) Reports' section. Slides 4-5 say Neb. Rev. Stat. section 70-1506(6) requires data center owner/operators to report annually to DWEE and the Legislature's Natural Resources Committee by 30 September (reporting period: calendar year 2025) on, among other things, the data center's name, developers and owners, size, street address and county, annual electricity demand and water use, tax exemptions, incentives, efficiency measures, renewable commitments and service life, and that the duty applies to facilities primarily used to store, manage and process digital data with a peak electricity demand of 10 MW or more (section 70-1506(1)(c)). Slide 6 lists the six reports received with their city and county and a state map of their locations: MARA Holdings (Compute North, LLC) Kearney (Buffalo); Google (Agate, LLC) Lincoln (Lancaster); Meta (Raven Northbrook, LLC) Springfield (Sarpy); Google (Fireball Group, LLC) Papillion (Sarpy); Travelers Insurance (Travelers Indemnity Co) Omaha (Sarpy); Google (Westwood Solutions, LLC) Omaha (Douglas). The map pins Westwood Solutions LLC at Omaha, Agate LLC at Lincoln and, in a Sarpy County inset, Fireball Groups LLC north of the Travelers and Raven Northbrook pins. Slides 7-11 (footprint, electricity, water, tax exemptions and incentives, efficiency, renewables and service life) list the Google entities with electricity, water and sales-tax figures redacted, Nebraska Advantage Act incentives (none under the ImagiNE Act) and a 25+ year service life, but their City (County) column differs from slide 6 for five of the six rows (for example Fireball Group 'Springfield (Sarpy)', Westwood Solutions 'Lincoln (Lancaster)', Agate 'Papillion (Sarpy)', Meta 'Omaha (Sarpy)').

status.summary: The City of Waukee's Planning and Zoning Commission staff report dated 23 October 2026, prepared for Apple, Inc.'s WKE.94 North Laydown site plan on its roughly 639-acre property north of Hickman Road and east of NW 30th Street, gives the property's existing land use as 'Apple Data Center Site', refers to 'the existing data center building' whose site plan the Commission and Council approved in April 2022, places relocated temporary facilities 'just off of the driveway located northwest of the existing data center building', and says photos of the existing buildings on site were provided. This dated government record supports that Apple's existing Waukee data-centre building has been built, as observed on 23 October 2026. The completion is scoped to that existing building: the report gives no completion, commissioning or opening date, does not say the building operates or whether the interior fit-out of the existing data center approved in June 2025 (AZ2) is finished, and states no capacity; the laydown area, guard shack, temporary buildings and access roads approved with Resolution #2026-432 on 2 November 2026 support 'future phases of development' and are not data-centre buildings.

status.summary: DataBank's DFW1 page, in its version modified on 27 September 2026, gives '(DFW1) 400 South Akard - Dallas, TX 75202' and says that the DFW1 facility, housing both DataBank's downtown Dallas data center and its headquarters, is the former Federal Reserve Building, 'serving as the city’s primary carrier hotel' with DWDM connections to the carrier hotel at 1950 North Stemmons; it lists 145,250 IT square feet, 7MW critical IT load, 47 onsite carriers, 2N power design, cabinet and cage colocation and 7x24x365 hours of operation. This records the facility as operating on 27 September 2026, the modification day of the captured version (bounded below by the Internet Archive copy of 26 August 2026, which carries dateModified 2026-08-13 and 44 onsite carriers, and above by the Internet Archive copy of 26 October 2026, which carries the same 27 September version; the live capture of 7 November 2026, the sitemap lastmod and the Dallas page version archived on 6 October 2026 agree). It is not an opening date, and 7MW is a design rating, not load in service.

additions.successor_review: The live page captured on 7 November 2026 carries the 27 September 2026 version (sitemap lastmod identical), as does the Internet Archive copy of 26 October 2026, the latest in the CDX listing captured the same day. DataBank's press-release sitemap captured the same day runs to 13 October 2026 and has no closure, sale or relocation item for DFW1 or the headquarters building. The project stays operational as of 27 September 2026.

additions.distinctness_review: Screened on 7 November 2026 against every row of sites.csv, projects.csv and evidence.csv, the source records and the identity mapping of verified_construction_core/2026-11-07-research-hundredthirtysecond (the current dataset; 1,129 sites, 1,216 projects and 6,719 evidence rows), every pending queue fragment's changes and holds, claims.tsv and all sources/*-holds.json, for DataBank DFW2, North Dallas Data Center, DataBank Richardson, 904 Quality Way, Quality Way, Collins Technology Park and parcel 42048780010120000: the Atlas's 'DFW2' hits are QTS South Dallas Campus (DFW2, Wilmer/Lancaster, 42 km away) and other operators' building codes, and no Atlas record names Quality Way or DataBank in Richardson. In the queue, the us-dfw-p5 lead_only hold (published in the ninety-first holds) lists DataBank's Richardson facility to be admitted by the route used here; the only other claims.tsv hits are this fragment's own claims. Within 2 km is one Atlas site: 365 Data Centers Richardson TX1 (1001 E Campbell Rd, 1.15 km; site and project), a different operator, address and parcel; the loc-12-p8 locator replacement queued for that same 365 Data Centers site (1.15 km) and its claim are likewise distinct. The next nearest Atlas sites are NTT Dallas Data Center Campus (5.6 km) and Digital Realty Garland Campus (5.7 km).

locator.identity_review: DataBank gives '(DFW2) 904 Quality Way - Richardson, TX 75081' and calls DFW2 a standalone data center with an on-site substation. TxGIO's parcel layer, filtered to situs number 904 on Quality Way around the address, returns one parcel, 42048780010120000 (legal area 4.338 acres; tax year 2026), owned of record by COLLINS TECHNOLOGY PARK PARTNERS LLC. DCAD's own parcel-publishing layer returns the same real-property account (BLK 1 LT 12 ACS 4.338, commercial improvements; outline centroid 1.0 m from the TxGIO centroid) and links business-personal-property accounts doing business as DATABANK and DATABANK NETWORK SERVERS to it, tying DataBank's own equipment to this parcel. The US Census geocoder's street-range point lies 180 m outside the parcel and is not used. The owner of record's relationship to DataBank (landlord or otherwise) is not published, so no owner role is asserted.
locator.precision: Centroid of Dallas County tax parcel 42048780010120000 at 904 Quality Way, Richardson (Block 1, Lot 12, 4.338 acres), as published in the TxGIO StratMap land-parcel service (4.33 geodesic acres, about 175 by 103 m). The point lies inside the parcel, 50.3 m from its boundary. It locates the data-center property, not a building footprint or surveyed boundary.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The StratMap parcel compilation publishes no positional accuracy for appraisal-district parcel polygons; the point represents a 4.3-acre property, and the building position within it is not published.
